claims.statement: The transaction and debt will cost an interest rate between 4.1% and 4.5%.
claims.quote: the debt will cost us roughly anywhere between 4.1 to 4.5% sort of interest rate at this point of time.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Goodwill and intangibles are anticipated to have a 70-30 split, with intangibles amortizable over eight years.
claims.quote: what we are right now anticipating is a 70-30 split in terms of the goodwill and intangibles. The intangibles will be amortizable over a period of eight years.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: The company does not intend to do any QIP or dilute its stake at this point in time.
claims.quote: We don't intend doing any QIP, just to be clear for everyone. We don't intend diluting our stake at this point in time.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The company has secured a financing commitment from Barclays for the transaction.
facts.quote: We are confident we have the Barclays financing commitment.

facts.statement: A share purchase agreement for a 21% stake from existing promoters is already in place.
facts.quote: 21% is something which we already got a share purchase agreement.
